description: $0.01 per call (x402, USDC on Base; the first call returns the payment terms, pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). Registration facts for a domain from the official registry RDAP service (successor to WHOIS): registered or not, registrar and IANA id, created / updated / expiry dates, age in days, days to expiry, EPP status codes, nameservers and DNSSEC. Personal contact data is never returned. Cached 24 h. ~0.5-3 s.

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. example.com (a URL or email address also works)
